Install Assignment

Purpose

This submission folder collects your work for Install Assignment.

Instructions

Please see CSC1060_Install for instructions. 

CSC1060InstallAssignment_yourlastname_welcome.java is a template to use for this assignment. Will need to customize with yourlastname in file name and .java main class. 

CSC1060InstallAssignment_yourlastname_test_results.docx is a template file to be used to submit your assignment compile. run and document this. Will need to customize with your lastname.  

What to submit

Submit the files required by the assignment directions. Allowed file types: .doc, .docx, .java, .pdf, .rtf.

How you will be assessed

This assignment is graded out of 25 points using the configured course rubric/criteria.

Multiple ways to show learning

Use comments in your files or a short note to explain your approach, testing, and decisions where relevant.

Help

If you need support before submitting, contact your instructor or approved course support channel. [INSTRUCTOR CONFIRM: tutoring/support options]

Next step

Review the checklist above, prepare your files, then upload and submit before the due date shown in Brightspace.
